files.turns.jsonl: one line per /api/chat call: scenario, question, HTTP status, latency and the full response (answer, sources, trace, stage timings, specialist observations with tool arguments/results, Critic verdict, model_usage)
files.cassette.jsonl.gz: every model call: masked request key, purpose, messages sent, tool names, response, tokens. Used by LLM_PROVIDER=replay
files.benchmark_report.json: the benchmark report of this run (latency, acceptance 1-18, orchestration)

privacy: Synthetic demo customers only. Credential scan (key prefix, bearer tokens, configured secret values) passed before export.
why_kept: First cloud run of V7 blocks 4-5, before the Critic/grounding fixes it motivated: 9/20 multi-intent answers escalated to a human because the model rejected issues it called minor, Payments records were cut from the Critic evidence, and the status check flagged generic wording. Kept as before/after evidence.
